title: Xanthe and the Hollow
author: Cyrus Ashgrove
blurb: Coral Sandoval, an exiled storm-caller, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
